scope: Focused native evidence, not final production acceptance; 1008 executable outcomes, 12 stack objects, 144 layout reviews (a subset of the executable outcomes).
method: Native generated-C O1/O2 outcomes; saved executable headers, symbols, sections and full disassembly inspected with Apple LLVM. ARC and tracing/stress semantics; allocation controls use ARC. Layout samples use O2 and both array-fusion/packed-array settings. No downloaded binary executed locally.
limits: Counts are instrumented, not timings. Static payloads initialized once per process. Individual frame sizes are not whole-stack bounds. Artifact identifiers and hashes locate original C, binaries, outputs and complete machine-code evidence.
